questions.question: Can useful computational coordinates and persistent-write coordinates self-align through experience rather than being supplied?
questions.discriminator: Compare oracle modal coordinates, fixed random coordinates, locally learned coordinates and task-trained coordinates under the same fast dynamics and state budget.
questions.result: TheoryLab v2 learned-basis-alignment PASS: covariance PCA recovered hidden coordinates with minimum alignment 0.987275; worst learned operator rank/composition exceeded best fixed-random controls across eight constructed worlds.
